title: wg: protocol-06 §5.8 identifierQuery result semantics unspecified
description: Suggestion. (1) Relation of IdentifierResponse.uri<V> to foundProfiles[].stableUri is unspecified (parallel? subset? duplicates?). (2) Response codes are described but no MUST ties them to the results (mimid: mimid-1wgh.5.71). (3) searchValue is commented 'a UTF8 string' but typed opaque (like §5.9 note). (4) Empty query_elements has no defined meaning (mimid: mimid-1wgh.5.73).
